summary: Frontend-only verification of redesigned auth flows on https://multi-tenant-refresh.preview.emergentagent.com — Login, Forgot, Reset, Invitation. All 9 functional requirements PASS (client-side validation, password toggle, help panel, forgot-link, safe non-technical error on failed sign-in, enumeration-safe acknowledgement on forgot, 12-char password policy on reset & invitation, consistent branded layout on desktop 1440x900 + mobile 402x860). Encountered a critical PREVIEW-ENVIRONMENT issue (not a code bug): browser requests to Vite dev-server module URLs containing URL-encoded null bytes (e.g. /@id/__x00__virtual:vite-rsc/entry-browser) are rejected with HTTP 403 by the preview ingress/WAF, so React never hydrates for a normal browser hitting the preview URL. Same URLs return 200 via curl. Tests were completed by using a Playwright route-interception proxy that fetched dev modules server-side (User-Agent curl) and fulfilled them to the browser, restoring hydration. Under this workaround every single client-side requirement was verified end-to-end. No source files were modified.

integration_issues.issue: Browser XHR to /@id/__x00__virtual:vite-rsc/entry-browser returns 403 from the preview ingress (URL-encoded %00 blocked by WAF). Same request via curl returns 200. Consequence: without a workaround, the preview site loads static SSR HTML but React never hydrates → all click handlers, validation, toggles, help panel are inert for real users of the preview URL. Only reproducible in a real browser through the preview domain; not a code defect.

issues: /login uses a large two-column branded layout (green brand panel + white card). The three helper pages use a simpler single centred card via auth-flow.module.css. They are internally consistent with one another and remain branded (H logo, SECURE ACCESS badge, heading, note, footer), but visually noticeably lighter than /login. Consider mirroring the brand panel on helper pages, or intentionally documenting this as the compact-flow style.

action_items: HIGHEST PRIORITY (infra, not code): The preview ingress/WAF returns 403 for URL-encoded %00 in path (browser-encoded form of the vite-rsc virtual module URL /@id/__x00__...). Real browsers cannot hydrate the app in this preview. Either (a) whitelist %00 for the dev-server module path on the preview ingress, (b) run a production build (`vite build` + static serve or a non-dev worker) behind the preview URL instead of the vinext dev server, or (c) confirm this is only a preview-env limitation and does not affect production. Note: from curl the same URL returns 200, so the block is WAF/User-Agent based.

MINOR (design consistency, not a functional bug): consider bringing the brand-panel visual language of /login to /password/forgot, /password/reset and /invitation/accept for a more uniform first-time impression, or explicitly keep the compact helper-card style as-is.
critical_code_review_comments: app/login/error-messages.ts correctly collapses all 4xx auth outcomes to a single friendly message (enumeration-safe). Good.
All four pages call event.preventDefault() and run local validation before any fetch — client-side validation cannot be bypassed by network. Good.

app/password/forgot/page.tsx sets `done=true` unconditionally after fetch (success OR non-ok status without a throw) — this is correct for enumeration safety; ensure it does not swallow a 5xx (currently a 5xx response.ok===false still triggers `setDone(true)` — that acknowledges even during outages, which arguably should surface `forgot-error` instead). Consider using `if (!response.ok && response.status >= 500) setError(unavailable) else setDone(true)`, still enumeration-safe.
Password inputs use maxLength=128 and autoComplete=new-password/current-password appropriately.
Help panel uses aria-expanded / role=note — good a11y.
No raw JSON, stack traces, or status codes ever appear in the visible error text under any tested path (empty / invalid email / valid-format credentials against unreachable API).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (9/9 functional requirements pass under hydration workaround)

context_for_next_testing_agent: The vinext dev server URL uses `/@id/__x00__virtual:...` module paths. Real browsers URL-encode the null byte to %00 which is blocked (403) by the preview WAF, preventing React hydration. To run Playwright tests on the preview URL you MUST intercept requests with page.route and proxy any request that (a) contains /@, /app/, /src/, /node_modules/, %00, ?import, ?v= or ends in .tsx/.ts/.module.css by fetching it with a plain HTTP client (User-Agent curl/8.0) and calling route.fulfill(). Without this, no data-testid interactions will fire because hydration silently fails. After proxying, all data-testids listed in the request work exactly as specified.
rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE (preview infra, not code): The vinext (Vite RSC) dev server generates virtual module URLs of the shape /@id/__x00__virtual:vite-rsc/entry-browser. In HTML the URL is served literally with a raw NUL byte, but browsers percent-encode the NUL as %00 when actually issuing the request. The preview ingress/Cloudflare WAF blocks any request path containing %00 (a common path-traversal-hardening rule) with a 403 before it reaches the origin. Curl leaves the NUL unencoded and is allowed through, so `curl` returns 200. REPRODUCTION: open DevTools Network tab on https://multi-tenant-refresh.preview.emergentagent.com/login → the request to /@id/__x00__virtual:vite-rsc/entry-browser shows 403; RUNTIME ERROR overlay says 'Failed to fetch dynamically imported module: .../app/login/page.tsx'. MITIGATION OPTIONS: (1) Adjust the preview WAF to allow %00 on the dev-server module route (or bypass WAF for the preview host); (2) serve a production `vite build` output behind the preview URL instead of the dev server; (3) change vinext/vite-rsc virtual-id encoding to avoid NUL in the URL (e.g. use a safe sentinel string) — this may require an upstream patch.
